original_content.script_excerpt: Deep below a mixed forest, threads of underground fungi connect different root systems into a living material-exchange network.
original_content.scene_goal: Without labels, see two distinct plant root systems bridged by a continuous third fungal network carrying signals along attached filaments.
new_subjects: distinct root and fungal transfer contacts
